question: What are play and independence in the context of Bhairava's nature?
premises: Divine play occurs where there is no concern with what should be rejected or accepted.
Play is the overflowing of the density of one's own bliss.
Independence is the will to abide in supremacy over all.
inference: Bhairava's play and independence are expressions of blissful sovereignty beyond dualistic valuation.
plain_english: Play is the overflowing of the density of one's own bliss in the absence of any talk of what is to be rejected or accepted; likewise, independence is the will to abide in supremacy over all.
